import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    target = data[1]

    open_count = target.count('(')
    close_count = target.count(')')

    starts = []
    ends = []
    for i, ch in enumerate(target):
        if ch == '(':
            starts.append(i)
        elif ch == ')':
            ends.append(i)

    count = 0
    for i in range(len(ends)):
        s = target[starts[i] + 1:ends[i]]
        parts = s.split('_')
        for part in parts:
            if part != '':
                count += 1

    extended_ends = [0] + ends
    extended_starts = starts + [len(target)]

    max_len = 0
    i = 1 if target[0] == '(' else 0
    while i < len(extended_ends):
        from_idx = extended_ends[i]
        if target[from_idx] == ')':
            from_idx += 1
        s = target[from_idx:extended_starts[i]]
        parts = s.split('_')
        for part in parts:
            if len(part) > max_len and '(' not in part and ')' not in part:
                max_len = len(part)
        i += 1

    print(max_len, count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
